title: Global menu interacts poorly with "focus follows mouse" setting
line: The Global Menu widget has a new option to show menus only for maximized windows.
explanation: The Global Menu always shows the active window's menu. With focus follows mouse, moving the pointer up to the panel crosses other windows and changes the active one, so the menu is only usable for maximized windows (or ones touching the panel); for the rest it is clutter, as the reporter says. The change adds a "Show menus only for maximized windows" checkbox to the widget's settings; when on, the menu model treats a non-maximized active window as having no menu (like an app without one) and follows maximize/restore changes live.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: add option to only show menus for maximized windows

With focus follows mouse, the global menu only works for windows that
touch the panel, so for the others it is just clutter. A new option in
the settings hides the menu while the active window isn't maximized.

BUG: 510765

media.caption: Unmaximized Konsole: its menu is always in the Global Menu
With the new option on, the Global Menu stays empty for the unmaximized window
New "Show menus only for maximized windows" option
With the option on, maximizing the window brings the menu back, and it opens normally

review.text: Small, focused option implemented in AppMenuModel next to allScreens, reacting live to IsMaximized changes; the applet collapses exactly as for apps without a menu. It follows existing patterns and the screenshots show the option and the empty menu for an unmaximized window. A new option for a wish is a maintainer call, but the earlier MR !5968 shows interest in the feature.
